question: Which of the following terms is NOT used in cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mid leg.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Terms used in Cricket:**

 
 
• Power-play,
 
• **Square leg,**
 
• **Gully,**
 
• **Fine leg**
 
• boundary,
 
• bowling,
 
• wicket,
 
• l.b.w,
 
• leg-bye,
 
• maiden over,
 
• no ball,
 
• off break,
 
• out,
 
• over,
 
• pitch,
 
• run out,
 
• sixer,
 
• straight drive,
 
• stumped,
 
• yorker.
 
 
 
• **Hence Mid leg is NOT used in cricket.**
